Scope: BOI only; both signs. IOSI excluded. Outcome priorities are proposed, not scientifically accepted.
AggregationRule: Record per-recording ingredients first; animal-level inference requires a comparison-specific plan.

Measurements.Name: Mean occupied tissue fraction
Measurements.Question: How much observable tissue is covered by detected events over time?
Measurements.Formula: sum_t area(union(native event masks at t) intersect eligible tissue at t) * dt_t / sum_t eligible tissue area_t * dt_t
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Native retained masks; no amplitude baseline. Tissue eligibility is estimated from detection-input intensity history.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Each overlapping pixel counts once within each sign. Current implementation uses static sign-specific tissue area and uniform frame intervals, clipped to the selected window.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: Valid zero requires successful analysis and positive tissue-time. Missing masks/invalid exposure are unavailable. Keep both signs separate; no cancellation. Exports distinguish unavailable native masks, zero analyzed tissue, and successful zero-event recordings.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Detected projected coverage, not hypoxic volume, oxygen concentration or tissue injury. Dynamic motion/exposure validity remains open.
Measurements.Implementation: helpers/computeOngoingRegionSeries.m; helpers/createOxygenAnalysisWindows.m: MeanOccupiedTissueFraction; helpers/createBOIRecordingInputContract.m: saved support and modeled frame intervals; helpers/createBOISurgeAnalysisWindows.m: separate SurgeRecordingWindowMetrics and SurgeWindowFrameIngredients using saved surge tissue support
Measurements.ImplementationStatus: static/uniform descriptive calculation with exported frame and window denominator ingredients; dynamic validity unresolved; both signs exported separately and inspectable, without cancellation

Measurements.Name: Detected event onset rate
Measurements.Question: How often do new detected events arise?
Measurements.Formula: count(eligible onsets in [window start, window end)) / valid tissue-time in mm2*min
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Saved event StartSec; current sink boundaries may be trace-refined. No amplitude baseline.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Window is half-open; ongoing events starting earlier contribute active time but no onset. Current code counts an event starting at acquisition frame 1.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: Retain split/merge, close-run and boundary uncertainty. Frame-1 boundary contact is not a confirmed new physiological onset. Failed recordings are not zero. AcquisitionStartEvents and AcquisitionStartOnsetsCounted expose saved-boundary contact; OnsetsAfterAcquisitionStart is diagnostic only. Existing rate remains unchanged.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Detected event identity is provisional. Acquisition-start censoring policy must be agreed before primary use.
Measurements.Implementation: helpers/createOxygenAnalysisWindows.m: EventOnsetRate_per_mm2_per_min; helpers/aggregateOxygenRecordingBurden.m; helpers/createBOISurgeAnalysisWindows.m: separate SurgeRecordingWindowMetrics and SurgeWindowFrameIngredients using saved surge tissue support
Measurements.ImplementationStatus: implemented descriptive rate; onset admission/censoring unresolved; both signs exported separately and inspectable, without cancellation
Measurements.WorkedExample: Teaching only: 4 new onsets / (0.5 mm2 * 2 min) = 4 events/mm2/min.

Measurements.Name: Mean concurrent event density
Measurements.Question: How many events are active at the same time per observable area?
Measurements.Formula: sum_event overlap duration with window / valid tissue-time (same time unit in numerator and denominator)
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Saved event intervals; no amplitude baseline. Current sink intervals can differ from native mask support.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Overlapping events each contribute event-time. Do not union event counts. Current code uses static area and uniform timing.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: Keep unresolved separation, truncation and valid exposure visible. Zero only for successful event-free analysis.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Identity-sensitive concurrent density; not tissue occupancy. Legacy Burden_Occupancy is numerically 60 times this value, expressed in event-seconds/mm2/min.
Measurements.Implementation: helpers/createOxygenAnalysisWindows.m: MeanConcurrentEvents_per_mm2; helpers/aggregateOxygenRecordingBurden.m: Burden_Occupancy; helpers/createBOISurgeAnalysisWindows.m: separate SurgeRecordingWindowMetrics and SurgeWindowFrameIngredients using saved surge tissue support
Measurements.ImplementationStatus: implemented under static exposure assumptions; both signs exported separately and inspectable, without cancellation
Measurements.WorkedExample: Teaching only: 120 event-seconds / (0.5 mm2 * 120 seconds) = 2 events/mm2; legacy scale = 120 event-seconds/mm2/min.

Measurements.Name: Event duration and timing
Measurements.Question: How long does the detected episode persist?
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Sink local trace boundary refinement; surge native-mask bounds. Preserve NativeStartFrame/NativeEndFrame separately.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Inclusive frame bounds represent half-open time intervals. Native masks need not fill refined sink intervals.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: Preserve TimingResolved, boundary contact and close-run flags; unresolved return is not recovery. Summaries need truncation policy.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Algorithmic duration, not established physiological onset/recovery. Empirical duration filters condition observed distributions.
Measurements.WorkedExample: Teaching only: frames 11 through 15 at 2 Hz span [5,7.5) seconds: 2.5 seconds.

Measurements.Name: Mean native projected event area
Measurements.Question: What projected area does a detected event occupy?
Measurements.Formula: mean over native active frames(number of native event pixels) * PixelSize^2
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Native event masks in full-image coordinates. No amplitude baseline.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Mean native-frame area, not the fixed union footprint used for amplitude. Current event area is not intersected with eligible tissue; occupancy is.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: Unavailable native masks or calibration means unavailable area. Preserve irregular morphology and support outside tissue as QC.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Projected area; no depth or volume inference. Area threshold and pixel-size effects require stratified assessment.
Measurements.ImplementationStatus: implemented; support difference must remain visible
Measurements.WorkedExample: Teaching only: mean 100 native pixels at 2 um/pixel = 400 um2.

Measurements.Name: Relative optical event amplitude
Measurements.Question: How pronounced is the preserved-input optical change?
Measurements.Formula: q(t)=(mean preserved-input intensity on fixed event footprint - B0)/B0; sink=-min(q); surge=max(q); percent=100*fraction
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Fixed union of native event pixels, traced through preserved input TIFF. B0 is mean of immediately preceding round(baselineSec*SampleF) clean samples; default 20 seconds.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Exclude baseline frames overlapping detected support of either sign. All requested clean pre-event samples are required; no post-event replacement. Peak uses saved event bounds.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: BaselineStatus and BaselineValidSamples distinguish missing clean context from zero. Negative directional amplitude stays negative; hypoxic composite rejects it.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Relative optical signal only. Clean means free of detected overlap, not proven free of biological change. Smooth/subthreshold predecessors may contaminate it.
Measurements.ImplementationStatus: implemented with baseline availability; scientific validity conditional
Measurements.WorkedExample: Teaching only: B0=100, minimum=80 gives sink amplitude 0.2 or 20%; signed change remains -0.2.

Measurements.Name: Signed trace integral
Measurements.Question: What signed optical change accumulates over the event interval?
Measurements.Formula: sum over saved event frames((I(t)-B0)/B0) / SampleF
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Same preserved-input fixed footprint and clean pre-event baseline as BOI-M06.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Uniform frame-interval rectangle sum, not trapezoidal endpoint integration. Saved event bounds, not area-time weighting.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: Unavailable baseline/event signal gives NaN. Preserve signed results and sign-specific summaries separately.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Relative optical trace integral; not oxygen deficit, delivered oxygen or damage. Within-event sign cancellation is visible in its trace.
Measurements.WorkedExample: Teaching only: two -0.2 samples at 2 Hz integrate to -0.2 fraction*seconds.

Measurements.Name: Local recurrence and event history
Measurements.Question: Do events repeatedly occupy the same projected location?
Measurements.Formula: native empty-frame gap=(next native start - previous native end - 1)/SampleF; retain ordered event/site history
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Native support, within recording and sign. Surge sites use a fixed first-event anchor; sink grouping uses existing spatial/trace refinement.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Gap differs from onset-to-onset recurrence interval. Both close neighbors flagged for gaps strictly below 20 seconds; no merging/exclusion solely from flag.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: No observed neighbor is unavailable/censored context, not infinite recurrence. Keep site assignment ambiguity and observation length.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Sites are local projected locations, not registered anatomical identities. Close-run threshold is a development review rule, not physiological truth.
Measurements.ImplementationStatus: native gaps/history implemented; confirmatory recurrence estimator unresolved
Measurements.WorkedExample: Teaching only: prior native end 10, next start 14 at 1 Hz gives 3 empty seconds, not 4.

Measurements.Name: Local recovery
Measurements.Question: Does local optical signal return toward its pre-event state before recurrence?
Measurements.Formula: not frozen: define baseline, return criterion, persistence and observation support before confirmatory estimation
Measurements.Units: not frozen; proposed seconds and relative signal
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Preserved local trace, explicit reference and intervening events of both signs.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Account for observation boundaries, unresolved separation and broad experimental response.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: Unresolved return, missing context, right censoring and absence of recurrence remain distinct.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Positive direction alone cannot distinguish recovery, spontaneous positive activity or stimulus/global increase.
Measurements.Implementation: No accepted recovery estimator; helpers/resolveSinkEventTiming.m is algorithmic boundary evidence only
Measurements.ImplementationStatus: unresolved; not released as physiological recovery
Measurements.WorkedExample: No numerical example until recovery definition is chosen.

Measurements.Name: Amplitude-area-duration composite
Measurements.Question: What combined event magnitude, projected area and duration is reported?
Measurements.Formula: sum_event positive-drop amplitude percent * mean native event area_um2 * event duration_sec
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: BOI-M06 amplitude, BOI-M05 area and BOI-M04 duration; same-event matching by explicit recording/site/event identity.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Events add even when support overlaps; mean native area multiplied by potentially refined duration. Not native union coverage or instantaneous pixelwise oxygen integral.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: Missing or wrong-direction contribution keeps total unavailable; export valid/total contribution counts. Zero only from successful event-free registry. No surge window composite is defined; its exported composite fields are NaN even in a successful zero-event recording.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Not a validated damage score. Matched acquisition alone does not validate physiology. Legacy name HypoxicBurden does not establish measured hypoxia.
Measurements.ImplementationStatus: implemented composite; scientific priority remains proposed
Measurements.WorkedExample: Teaching only: 20 percent * 400 um2 * 2.5 seconds = 20000 percent*um2*seconds.

Measurements.Name: Experimental response and positive dynamics
Measurements.Question: How does local or broad optical signal relate to experimental state?
Measurements.Formula: comparison-specific baseline, response window and within-animal contrast must be prespecified; do not infer from sign
Measurements.Units: depends on chosen trace/contrast; retain explicit units
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Preserved global/ROI signal plus separate sink/surge outputs. Do not substitute detrended z-scores for relative intensity response.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Only approved, aligned experimental windows support biological contrasts; default whole-recording and diagnostic windows are not protocol evidence.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: Unknown timing blocks affected response claim. FB2360 switch times and short whisker alignment remain unresolved; recovered KX pulse times still need frame correspondence.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: No mechanism from positive signal alone. State-associated comparisons retain preparation/order/acquisition confounds.
Measurements.ImplementationStatus: contrast arithmetic available; comparison-specific window/baseline validity unresolved
Measurements.WorkedExample: Teaching only: B=10 and response=12 gives difference 2 and +20%; B=0 gives unavailable relative change.

Measurements.Name: Measurement availability
Measurements.Question: Which observations support the reported value and which are unavailable?
Measurements.Formula: finite measurements / detected events, plus separate counts by reason, sign, recording, animal and acquisition stratum
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: EventMeasurementQC, baseline statuses, recording registry and load/failure records.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Denominators must identify eligible versus detected versus measured observations. No complete-case substitution without reporting losses.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: Zero events gives zero event counts and unavailable event availability fraction; a failed recording must not become a zero-event success.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Numerical availability and baseline validity are not detector sensitivity or biological accuracy.
Measurements.Implementation: helpers/createOxygenMeasurementQC.m; helpers/createAnalysisRecordingRow.m; StatsLoadIssues; helpers/resolveBOIAcquisitionMetadata.m; RecordingInputQC and WindowFrameIngredients
Measurements.ImplementationStatus: event availability plus input assumptions, actionable QC and window exposure ingredients exported; scientific eligibility unresolved
Measurements.WorkedExample: Teaching only: 3 finite amplitudes among 5 detections = 0.6; retain reasons for the other 2.

Measurements.Name: Animal-level summaries and contrasts
Measurements.Question: What is the variation between biological replicates?
Measurements.Formula: current descriptive path: arithmetic mean of recordings within mouse/group, then equal-weight mean across finite mouse summaries
Measurements.Units: inherits measurement units; per-metric animal N
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Recording summaries with explicit metadata, pairs and measurement availability.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Animals are biological replicates; recordings, sites, events and frames are dependent. Weighting/model/contrasts must match each comparison.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: Current strict mean leaves an incomplete mouse unavailable for affected metric; export NValidMice. SEM unavailable with fewer than two valid mice.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Descriptive aggregation is not a frozen inferential model. Do not assume sample size or expected treatment effect determines tuning.
Measurements.ImplementationStatus: descriptive implementation; R4 statistical plan unresolved
Measurements.WorkedExample: Teaching only: mouse A recordings 2 and 4 -> 3; mouse B recording 9 -> 9; equal-mouse mean=6.

Measurements.Name: Spatial and cross-sign association
Measurements.Question: How do events relate spatially to vessels or temporally across signs?
Measurements.Formula: not frozen: define spatial/time support, alignment, null model and dependent sampling before interpretation
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Native support and available registered auxiliary annotations; original coordinate transforms retained.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Recording-local coordinates; no cross-session anatomical matching without registration evidence.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: Missing annotation/alignment blocks affected association, not all BOI metrics.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Correlation does not establish mechanism or anatomical identity; no measured volume claims.
Measurements.Implementation: helpers/computeVascularDistances.m and vascular entry points; no frozen cross-sign estimator
Measurements.WorkedExample: No inferential example before support and null model are specified.
